get.description: Returns final (and voided) GRN invoices and CN credit notes of the API key's business unit as vendor-invoice records with one line per received / returned item, ordered by document date, document no, doc type and id, paginated across all requested types. The business unit is taken from the API key; any `bu_code` in the query is ignored. Drafts are never exported, and a document left with no line (e.g. only consignment lines) is not returned. A document is in exactly one endpoint: GRN / CN here, SR / SI / SO in `/gl-journals`. CN amounts are positive; reverse them on your side by `doc_type`. Each line carries three accounts named by role (inventory = `debit_*`, payable = `ap_*`, input VAT = `tax_*`), not by side. Line `description` is the product name. `tax_type` is `add` when the line base tax is not 0, else `none` (`included` is reserved and never emitted). The tax account / cost center are set only on taxed lines and the tax cost center equals `debit_cost_center_code`. `qty`, `price`, `tax_rate` and `exchange_rate` are decimal strings without trailing-zero padding (e.g. `"10"`, `"7"`); money fields are 2-decimal strings. Lines with `unmapped: true` carry the correct amount but need an account fixed in the GL / AP mapping in Carmen; `issues` lists `{ account: "debit" | "ap" | "tax" | null, code }`. Each field description names its Carmen 4 column where there is one.

info.title: Carmen External API
info.description:
Read-only API for external systems (for example a customer's accounting system) to pull data out
of **Carmen**. Each request is authenticated with a **per-business-unit API key**, not a user login,
and only ever sees the data of the business unit (BU) the key belongs to.

Currently available:

- **AP invoices** (`GET /api/ext/v1/ap-invoices`) — committed GRN (vendor invoices) and CN
  (credit notes) with one line per item and the inventory, payable and input-VAT accounts mapped
  in Carmen.
- **GL journals** (`GET /api/ext/v1/gl-journals`) — committed SR, SI and SO as balanced Dr/Cr
  journals with the GL accounts mapped in Carmen.

**A document is in exactly one endpoint** (GRN / CN in AP invoices, SR / SI / SO in GL journals), so
importing both never double-posts: an AP invoice already produces its own GL entry in your
accounting system.

## 1. Get an API key

An administrator of the BU (with the `system_admin.bu_api_key` permission) opens
**Interface → Export tools → External → API Access** in Carmen and creates the key. The page shows
the **client id**, the **secret** (reveal on demand) and the base URL to call.

- One key per business unit. The BU needs the External interface license.
- **Regenerate** issues a new secret and the old secret stops working **immediately**.
- Keep the secret in an environment variable or secret store. Never commit it or put it in a URL.

## 2. Base URL

```
<your Carmen API host>/api/ext/v1
```

The host differs per environment; use the URL shown on the API Access page.

## 3. Authentication

Send both headers on every request (no `Authorization` header is needed):

| Header | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `x-client-id` | Client id of the key |
| `x-client-secret` | Secret of the key |

In this page, click **Authorize** and fill in both values to try the endpoint.

## 4. Quick start

```bash
export CARMEN_API="https://<your Carmen API host>"
export CARMEN_CLIENT_ID="<client id>"
export CARMEN_CLIENT_SECRET="<secret>"

curl -sS -G "$CARMEN_API/api/ext/v1/ap-invoices" \
  -H "x-client-id: $CARMEN_CLIENT_ID" \
  -H "x-client-secret: $CARMEN_CLIENT_SECRET" \
  --data-urlencode "date_from=2026-10-01" \
  --data-urlencode "date_to=2026-10-31" \
  --data-urlencode "doc_types=GRN,CN" \
  --data-urlencode "perpage=50"
```

## 5. Pagination

Responses carry `paginate: { total, page, perpage, pages }`. Request `page=1,2,…` until
`page >= pages`. `perpage` is 1–200 (default 50). Documents are ordered by document date,
document no, doc type and id, across all requested types. Both endpoints take the same query
(`date_from`, `date_to`, `date_field`, `doc_types`, `page`, `perpage`); a `doc_types` value that
belongs to the other endpoint is a 400.

## 6. Incremental sync (recommended)

Documents can be edited or voided after you first read them, so do not rely on the document date alone:

1. First run: `date_field=document` over the periods you need; page through all results.
2. Each later run: `date_field=updated`, `date_from` = the day of your last successful sync
   (one day earlier for safety), `date_to` = today.
3. Upsert by `(doc_type, id)` — the latest version wins — and replace all lines of the document,
   since line grouping and mapping can change.
4. A range spans at most 366 days (inclusive).

## 7. Errors

All errors share one body: `{ success: false, status, message, timestamp, path, error? }`.

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Invalid query parameters; `error.errors` lists the issues. |
| 401 | `Invalid API credentials` — missing header, unknown client id, wrong secret, inactive key or BU. Same body for every cause. |
| 403 | The API is not enabled (or the method is not GET — HEAD is rejected too), or the BU's External interface license is missing or expired. |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded. Back off and retry. |
| 503 | Temporarily unavailable (allowlist not loaded, or the license could not be verified). Retry later. |

## 8. Rate limits

- **300 requests per minute per API key** (fixed one-minute window).
  Requests rejected with 403 or 429 still count.
- A global **per-source-IP** limit (300 per minute by default) also applies, so several keys polled
  from the same IP can be throttled before reaching their per-key limit.

x-client-id.name: x-client-id
x-client-id.description: Client id of the business unit API key

x-client-secret.name: x-client-secret
x-client-secret.description: Secret of the business unit API key

account.description: Which account of the line the issue belongs to; null when it is not tied to one account (e.g. missing_location, cost_not_found)

code.description: Reason code, e.g. missing_location, missing_product, missing_item_group, missing_input_vat_account, cost_not_found, mapping_target_not_found, missing_inventory_account, missing_ap_account, missing_cost_center, missing_direct_account, account_not_in_coa. Treat an unknown code as "unmapped, needs review".

qty.description: Received (GRN) / returned (CN) quantity. Decimal string without trailing-zero padding (Carmen 4: InvdQty)

price.description: Unit price BEFORE discount, in the document currency. Decimal string without trailing-zero padding. `net_amount` is AFTER discount, so `qty` x `price` may differ from `net_amount` (GRN `qty` also excludes FOC quantity) (Carmen 4: InvdPrice)

net_amount.description: Amount before tax, document currency, 2 decimals (Carmen 4: NetAmt)

base_net_amount.description: Amount before tax, base currency, 2 decimals (Carmen 4: NetBaseAmt / InvdAbfTax)

tax_type.description: `add` when the line base tax is not 0, else `none`. `included` is reserved and never emitted (Carmen 4: InvdTaxT1, N / A / I)

tax_rate.description: Tax rate in percent. Decimal string without trailing-zero padding (Carmen 4: InvdTaxR1)

tax_amount.description: Tax, document currency, 2 decimals (Carmen 4: InvdTaxC1 — C = document currency)

base_tax_amount.description: Tax, base currency, 2 decimals (Carmen 4: InvdTaxA1 — A = base currency)

total_amount.description: net_amount + tax_amount, document currency, 2 decimals (Carmen 4: TotalPrice)

debit_account_code.description: Inventory account — the debit side of a GRN, the credit side of a CN (Carmen 4: InvdBTaxDr)

debit_cost_center_code.description: Cost center of the inventory account (Carmen 4: DeptCode)

ap_account_code.description: Payable (AP) account — the credit side of a GRN, the debit side of a CN (Carmen 4: InvdBTaxCr1)

ap_cost_center_code.description: Cost center of the payable account (Carmen 4: InvdBTaxCr1DeptCode)

tax_account_code.description: Input VAT account of the business unit. Only on taxed lines; null when the line has no tax (Carmen 4: InvdT1Dr)

tax_cost_center_code.description: Cost center of the input VAT account — equal to debit_cost_center_code. Only on taxed lines (Carmen 4: InvdT1DrDeptCode)

unmapped.description: true when an account of the line could not be resolved or an issue is set. The amounts are still correct; the account needs fixing in the GL / AP mapping

issues.description: Empty when the line is fully mapped

id.description: Document id. Your own key is (doc_type, id)

doc_type.description: GRN = vendor invoice; CN = credit note (amounts positive — reverse by doc_type)

doc_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the business unit timezone

status.description: voided keeps the original amounts — reverse on your side

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update; filter on it with date_field=updated

tax_invoice_no.description: Tax invoice no. GRN: same as invoice_no (a GRN has no separate tax invoice field); CN: its own tax invoice no (Carmen 4: InvhTInvNo)

tax_invoice_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, same rule as tax_invoice_no (Carmen 4: InvhTInvDt)

due_date.description: GRN only, YYYY-MM-DD; null on a CN (Carmen 4: InvhDueDate)

credit_term_days.description: GRN only; null on a CN (Carmen 4: InvhCredit)

exchange_rate.description: Rate to base currency. Decimal string without trailing-zero padding (Carmen 4: CurRate)

ref_grn.description: CN only: the GRN it credits; null on a GRN or a CN without a GRN (Carmen 4: InvhRef)

credit_note_type.description: CN only; null on a GRN

net_amount.description: Sum of line net_amount, document currency, 2 decimals

tax_amount.description: Sum of line tax_amount, document currency, 2 decimals

total_amount.description: net_amount + tax_amount, document currency, 2 decimals (Carmen 4: InvhTotalAmt)

base_net_amount.description: Sum of line base_net_amount, base currency, 2 decimals

base_tax_amount.description: Sum of line base_tax_amount, base currency, 2 decimals

unmapped.description: true when any line is unmapped

side.description: Debit or credit (Carmen 4: TransDrCr, D / C)

role.description: What the line posts: inventory / adjustment (SI, SO) or sr_in / sr_out (SR)

account_code.description: GL account resolved from the GL mapping; null when it could not be resolved (Carmen 4: AccCode)

amount.description: Non-negative decimal string, base currency, 2 decimals. `0.00` when issue is `cost_not_found` (Carmen 4: JvdBAmt; JvdAmt is the same since GL documents are in base currency)

unmapped.description: true when account_code is null or issue is set. The amount is still correct; the account needs fixing in the GL mapping

issue.description: Reason code when the line is unmapped, e.g. missing_location, missing_product, missing_item_group, missing_adjustment_type, cost_not_found, mapping_target_not_found, missing_inventory_account, missing_adjustment_account, missing_cost_center, missing_direct_account, account_not_in_coa. Treat an unknown code as "unmapped, needs review".

description.description: Product name; null for a line without a product

id.description: Document id. Your own key is (doc_type, id)

doc_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the business unit timezone (Carmen 4: JvhDate)

status.description: voided only for SI/SO voided after completion; keeps the original amounts — reverse on your side

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update; filter on it with date_field=updated

description.description: Header description of the document (Carmen 4: JvhDesc)

currency_code.description: Business unit base currency; GL documents are in base currency. Reference only

exchange_rate.description: Rate to base currency. Decimal string without trailing-zero padding. Reference only

adjustment_type.description: Adjustment type of an SI / SO; null otherwise

balanced.description: true when total Dr equals total Cr. Amounts are never adjusted to force a balance (SR FIFO rounding or a dropped consignment side can make it false)
